newsitem.title: UK: Pillar in 20 mln stg site development plan.
newsitem.headline: Pillar in 20 mln stg site development plan.

text.p: Pillar Property Investments Plc said it had exchanged agreements for lease with The Burton Group to redevelop a retail site in Leeds, northern England, in a 20 million stg project.
It said it bought the 85,000 square foot property as an investment in 1991 with Debenhams, one of the Burton Group's store chains, as a tenant on long lease to 2077.
It has since added another retail unit, giving 106,277 square feet of gross internal retail accomodation.
Debenhams will surrender the existing lease on vacation at the end of January 1997 and the Burton Group has agreed a new 35-year lease at rent above one million stg, Pillar said.
